body_markdown:
[Back to All](https://docs.decentro.tech/changelog)


added


###


Advisory : Allowing Merchant to send the PDN for debit date upto T+3 Day and to keep multiple PDN active in the system.


####


Deployment Date : 19th November 2026


We are enhancing how Pre-Debit Notifications (PDNs) work for UPI AutoPay. These changes let the merchants notify users further in advance and keep more than one Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) active on a mandate, so scheduled debits, especially on Daily mandates, are not skipped because a new Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) had to wait for the previous debit to finish.


1.


###


What is changing ?


1.


####


Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) debit date can now be up to T+3 Day.


You can now send a PDN on T-Day with a` debit_date` of up to T+3 Day (earlier limit: T+2 Day)
**Eg :** For a mandate with frequency as **Daily** or **Aspresented** , on 3rd November 2026, you can send the Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) for the` debit_date` of 4th November 2026 or 5th November 2026 or 6th November 2026 or for all the` debit_dates` mentioned above (all 3 days in advance and all at once).
• A` debit_date` beyond T+3 will be rejected with` error_invalid_debit_date` .
• The minimum 24-hour gap between PDN and debit (NPCI rule) and the 23:50–00:00 cutoff for T+1 PDNs remain unchanged.
• The` debit_date` must fall within the mandate's start and end dates.


2.


####


Multiple active Pre-Debit Notifications (PDNs) per mandate.


Today, sending a new PDN cancels any earlier PDN on the same mandate that has not yet been presented. After this change, the behaviour depends on the mandate frequency:


Frequency Active PDNs allowed Does a new PDN cancel earlier ones?


As Presented Up to 7 per debit date, i.e. up to 21 across T+1, T+2 and T+3 No. Earlier PDNs stay active.


Daily 1 per debit date, i.e. up to 3 across T+1, T+2 and T+3 No. A second PDN for the same debit date is rejected.


Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly and others 1 at a time (one debit per frequency cycle) No change to current behaviour


1. For Aspresented mandates, active PDNs can be presented in any order for a same debit date, a later PDN can be presented before an earlier one for the same debit date.
2. For Daily Frequency mandate: On 10th Nov'26 you can send PDNs for 11th Nov, 12th Nov and 13th Nov. Each can be presented once on its own debit date.
3. **Note:**


1. PDN should be presented on their respective debit dates. No carry forward.
2. If PDN is not presented on the debit date, then it'll be marked as **Expired** .


3.


####


Addition of new field :` debit_date_end_time` in the callbacks and the Get Transaction Status (GTS) response


Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) callbacks and the Get Transaction Status (GTS) response will include a new field:


```text
"debit_date_end_time": "2026-11-13 23:59:59"


```


1. For all frequencies, a Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) that has not been presented by 23:59:59 IST on its debit date will move to **Expired** and can no longer be presented. Each PDN expires independently which means, if the T+1 PDN expires, the T+2 and T+3 PDNs are unaffected.


4.


####


Presentation rules :


The Presentation API will accept any active` notification_sequence_id` on the mandate. A presentation will be accepted only if:


1. The Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) is in` success` status and has not already been presented.
2. The presentation is made within the Pre-Debit Notification's (PDN's) window (from` debit_date` to` debit_date_end_time` ).
3. The presentation amount exactly matches the Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) amount.
4. Re-presentations after an eligible failure are still allowed while` remaining_presentation_attempts` is above zero, but they must also complete before the PDN's` debit_date_end_time` .
5. If a presentation failed for example, at 11:30 PM and if it had a representable error code, the next re-presentation attempt would fall after 23:59:59, the presentation will be marked` Failed` and the Pre-Debit Notification (PDN)` completed` .


5.


####


Pause and revoke :


1. If a mandate is` paused` or` revoked` , all of its active Pre-Debit Notifications (PDNs) will be moved to` cancelled` .


2.


###


New error responses


Scenario response_key


` debit_date` is more than T+3 Day` error_invalid_debit_date`


As Presented: an 8th active PDN for the same debit date` error_active_pdn_limit_exceeded`


Daily and other frequencies (except aspresented frequency) : a second active PDN for the same debit date` error_active_pdn_exists_for_debit_date`


3.


###


Action required from you


1. Handle the new` response_key` listed above in your PDN integration.
2. Accept the new` debit_date_end_time` field in callbacks and GTS responses. If your parser rejects unknown fields, update it before go-live.
3. For As Presented and Daily mandates, a new PDN will no longer cancel the previous one. If you currently re-send a PDN to correct an amount or date, the earlier PDN will remain active, make sure you present only the Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) you intend to debit.
4. Always use the` notification_sequence_id` returned in the PDN callback when calling the Presentation API. For Daily mandates, sequence numbers are derived from the debit date and may not be consecutive; do not compute them on your side.
5. Schedule presentations early in the debit day so that any re-presentations can complete before 23:59:59 IST.
6. Daily mandates: to avoid missed debits, send Pre-Debit Notifications (PDNs) for upcoming dates (T+2 or T+3 day) in advance rather than waiting for the previous debit to complete.


4.


###


What is not changing


1. Multiple debits on the same day are possible only for As Presented mandates. All other frequencies still allow one debit per debit date / cycle.
2. The 24-hour minimum notice and the T+1 cutoff window.
3. Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) statuses (Pending, Success, Failed, Completed, Cancelled, Expired) remain the same. No new status is introduced.


For any further queries you may reach out to us.
